europe_now.title: German Regional Elections
europe_now.summary: Germany's far-right AfD party has secured notable victories and strong gains in two key state elections. These regional ballot outcomes present renewed political pressure and a potential major blow for Chancellor Friedrich Merz.

sources.headline: Germany’s far-right AfD makes strong gains in two state elections
Germany’s far right secures another win in key regional election, exit poll says

europe_now.title: Massive Drone Attack on Moscow
europe_now.summary: Ukraine launched an extensive drone barrage targeting Moscow as the final day of Russian elections concluded. The large-scale military operation included hundreds of drones hitting targets such as a local refinery.

sources.headline: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia in "largest ever" attack on Moscow
Massive Ukrainian drone attack hits Moscow on last day of Russian elections

top_stories.title: German Regional Elections and Political Fallout
top_stories.summary: Voters across two German states participated in regional elections that could determine the political fate of Chancellor Friedrich Merz. Exit polls indicate that the far-right Alternative for Germany achieved significant electoral success in these contests.

sources.headline: Germany’s far-right AfD makes strong gains in two state elections
Germany’s far right secures another win in key regional election, exit poll says

top_stories.title: Ukraine Drone Strike During Russian Elections
top_stories.summary: Ukrainian forces executed a massive drone assault targeting Moscow and an oil refinery on the final day of voting in Russia. Officials described the offensive as a remarkably large aerial operation conducted amid ongoing regional conflict.
